intro: Long-term structural theses as of June 28, 2026 (Sunday morning). The defining development since the June 27 briefing: Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix will jointly unveil a $646B–$700B investment package at the Blue House on June 29 (President Lee Jae Myung, Samsung Chairman Lee Jae-yong, SK Hynix CEO Kwak Noh-jung) — the largest corporate investment commitment in Korean history, exceeding South Korea's entire annual government budget. Samsung: ~$194B in semiconductor plants (Honam) and ~$226B in AI data centers over 10 years. SK Hynix: $29.4B ADR proceeds for HBM4E capacity. This Blue House announcement is a structural inflection point for the AI memory supercycle: it confirms that national-government-scale capital is being committed to AI infrastructure at a rate that makes the Morningstar supply-glut thesis (AI memory revenue peaks 2028, halves by 2030) categorically untenable. Near-term regime volatility (VIX 18.41, DXY 101.27, SPX 7,354; NVDA Stop Day 1 active; BTC Day 6 exit gate; SPCX bond distribution Day 5) does not alter these structural 1–5 year theses. The Samsung Blue House announcement is the most significant structural development since Micron's $50B Q4 guide — it confirms that the world's largest electronics company has committed national-strategic-scale capital to AI infrastructure that requires NVDA silicon, SK Hynix HBM4, and Micron DRAM at multi-decade demand curves no single hyperscaler quarterly earnings call could establish.

ideas.name: NVIDIA Corporation
ideas.idea: NVIDIA is the dominant AI infrastructure platform for the 2020s decade. Samsung Blue House June 29 ($226B AI data centers) is the most powerful demand-side validation of NVDA's long-term TAM ever announced at a single corporate event. The near-term Stop Day 1 framework does not change the 2–4 year structural thesis — it creates the entry discipline for optimal long-term positioning.
ideas.why: Samsung's $226B AI data center commitment is a multi-decade demand confirmation that cannot be generated by any single hyperscaler earnings call. At current GPU cluster pricing, $226B in AI data centers implies 40,000–80,000+ NVDA B200/B300/Vera Rubin GPU clusters over the investment horizon. Vera Rubin platform (6 new H3 chips, RTX Spark for Windows AI PC) + CUDA ecosystem (5M+ developers) creates switching costs that exceed hardware replacement cycles. SK Hynix ADR $29.4B (HBM4E sole-source for Vera Rubin) + Micron $50B Q4 HBM4 guide + Samsung $226B AI data centers = the entire demand-supply ecosystem for NVDA's primary market is validated simultaneously at institutional underwriting scale. NIM microservices and NVIDIA AI Enterprise evolve NVDA from hardware to software platform with recurring revenue. $80B buyback + $0.25/share dividend signal management confidence in sustained free cash flow.
ideas.driver: Samsung $226B AI data center buildout over 10 years (2026–2034/35); Vera Rubin (H3) and H4/H5 GPU architecture cycles (2027–2029); NIM/NEMO software platform attach rate increasing; inference silicon demand expanding beyond training; sovereign AI infrastructure spending (India, Japan, Korea-Blue House, Saudi Arabia, UAE); Q2 FY27 earnings (~Aug 26, $91B guide).
ideas.risk: US export control expansion cutting Chinese revenue (~15% of total); AMD MI400 series gaining meaningful inference share; custom silicon (GOOGL TPU v5, AMZN Trainium3, MSFT Maia 2) displacing NVDA for specific hyperscaler workloads; Samsung's own AI chip development ($194B semiconductor plants) eventually targeting NVDA's datacenter market; CUDA monopoly regulatory action.

ideas.name: SK Hynix Inc.
ideas.idea: SK Hynix is the structural winner of the HBM3E/HBM4/HBM4E cycle with the most significant catalyst development of the 2026 cycle: Samsung Blue House joint announcement June 29 ($646B combined, $226B Samsung AI data centers = SK Hynix demand validation) + Nasdaq ADR listing confirmed July 10 ($29.4B, underwriters BofA/Goldman/Citigroup/JPMorgan) + Korean presidential endorsement. The KOSPI circuit-breaker sessions (June 23, June 26) are tactical, not structural. The ADR permanently opens US passive fund demand channels.
ideas.why: Samsung $226B in AI data center capex is the largest single external demand confirmation of SK Hynix's HBM4E market thesis ever announced. At 58% HBM market share in a structurally sold-out 2026 market, SK Hynix is the irreplaceable supply bottleneck for the AI compute build Samsung is committing to at the presidential level. The Blue House framing (Samsung and SK Hynix as collaborative national champions) reduces the competitive HBM expansion risk from Samsung's $194B semiconductor plant commitment. ADR $29.4B underwriting: Goldman, BofA, Citigroup, JPMorgan collectively verified HBM4E customer contracts, production yield, and pricing before committing. Q2 KST earnings July 29 will be the first with ADR capital raise AND Samsung Blue House demand context — a uniquely powerful earnings setup.
ideas.driver: Blue House June 29 presidential endorsement (eliminates forced-liquidation cascade risk); ADR Nasdaq July 10 listing — permanent US passive fund demand; Samsung $226B AI data centers (SK Hynix HBM4E demand validation at national scale); HBM4E sole-source qualification for NVIDIA B300/Vera Rubin+ platform; Q2 KST earnings July 29 (first HBM4E revenue recognition); DRAM pricing recovery cycle 2027.
ideas.risk: Samsung semiconductor plant ($194B Honam) includes competing HBM4E production undermining SK Hynix 58% market share premium; KOSPI two consecutive closes below ₩2,540,000 stop — technical stop-out before structural recovery; ADR pricing disappointment; Samsung Blue House collaborative framing breaks down at commercial product competition level; US-Korea trade policy changes.

ideas.name: Micron Technology
ideas.idea: Micron is the US-listed HBM supercycle proxy and the only domestically headquartered HBM supplier — Samsung Blue House June 29 ($226B AI data centers) is the most powerful external demand confirmation of Micron's $50B Q4 FY2026 guide ever announced by a non-US entity. Russell Growth reclassification (June 26) permanently adds MU to the passive Growth channel ($2T+ in Growth ETF demand).
ideas.why: Micron's $50B Q4 FY2026 guide is the most powerful earnings beat in 2026 AI cycle history (40%+ above prior consensus). HBM3E and HBM4 capacity sold out through 2026. Samsung $226B in AI data centers requires HBM memory — at current memory pricing, $226B in AI data center capex implies multi-year HBM demand that extends the sold-out supply cycle well beyond 2026. Goldman, BofA, Citigroup, JPMorgan would not underwrite the SK Hynix $29.4B ADR unless they confirmed multi-year HBM demand was real — and they did the same diligence that validates Micron's guide. CHIPS Act manufacturing (Idaho fab) + Samsung Blue House demand context = US HBM supply at national-strategic priority.
ideas.driver: Samsung $226B AI data centers (SK Hynix + Micron are the supply duopoly); HBM4 mass production 2H 2026; DRAM pricing inflection (tight supply + AI PC + inference demand); Q4 FY2026 earnings (September 2026, confirming $50B guide); CHIPS Act Idaho fab expansion; Blue House demand validates the Micron cycle duration vs. Morningstar 2028-peak thesis.
ideas.risk: Samsung semiconductor plant ($194B Honam) includes DRAM competition that undercuts Micron pricing; Samsung DRAM price-cuts aggressively to regain share; US-China trade war escalation reduces hyperscaler spending; memory downcycle triggered by hyperscaler inventory digestion 2027–2028; Morningstar supply-glut thesis gains consensus despite Samsung Blue House counter-evidence.

ideas.name: Microsoft Corporation
ideas.idea: Microsoft Azure is the enterprise AI moat for the decade. Samsung Blue House June 29 ($226B AI data centers at national-government scale) re-rates the global AI infrastructure TAM upward — Samsung's AI data centers are computing demand BEYOND what Azure and US hyperscalers are already building; this incremental $226B validates that global AI compute demand is larger than current consensus estimates, directly expanding MSFT's long-term AI revenue potential. Consumer price increases (Xbox, M365) demonstrate pricing power across every tier.
ideas.why: Azure is #2 hyperscaler growing faster than AWS on AI workloads. OpenAI partnership gives MSFT exclusive commercial rights to GPT-5/6 on Azure. Copilot for M365 (1.4B Office users, 350M paid M365 subscribers) is the largest enterprise AI distribution channel in history. GitHub Copilot (1.4M+ paid seats, 50%+ YoY growth) dominates developer AI tools. Samsung $226B AI data centers will run Azure-compatible workloads and enterprise software — MSFT benefits as the AI software layer regardless of hardware vendor. Samsung's national-strategic AI commitment is the most powerful external validation of the 'AI compute demand is secular' thesis that underpins MSFT's $50B+ Azure AI capex plan.
ideas.driver: Samsung Blue House demand re-rates global AI TAM; Azure AI revenue overtaking GCP for AI workloads (2027); Copilot 365 attach rate inflecting >20% of M365 base; AGI timeline acceleration benefits OpenAI exclusivity; GitHub Copilot enterprise expansion; Xbox Game Pass + AI gaming.
ideas.risk: OpenAI relationship deteriorates or exclusivity ends early; GOOGL Workspace + Gemini gains enterprise share faster than MSFT Copilot; antitrust action on Azure bundling; Samsung builds Azure-competitive AI cloud platform with the $226B data center commitment, reducing MSFT global cloud share; AI CapEx creates cost overruns compressing Azure margins.

ideas.name: Meta Platforms Inc.
ideas.idea: Meta is the cheapest full-stack AI company on a PEG basis among large-cap tech. The Qualcomm Dragonfly AI inference chip (META as anchor customer) is a structural hedge against NVIDIA dependency not yet priced. Samsung Blue House ($226B AI data centers) creates the AI compute demand context that benefits Meta's advertising AI: more compute = more AI ad targeting optimization = higher CPM growth for META's $160B+ annual ad revenue.
ideas.why: META's 3.2B daily active users across Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp, and Threads provide the largest AI training data corpus of any consumer platform. Llama 4 open-source is competitive with GPT-4o and being deployed at scale in Meta AI. Reality Labs losses decelerating to −$5.1B Q1 2026 (improving from −$7.9B Q4 2025) while Quest 3/Ray-Ban Meta finding product-market fit. Samsung $226B AI data centers at national-government scale = global AI compute demand for advertising AI optimization is secular, not cyclical — this is the most powerful demand validation for Meta's AI-driven ad growth thesis. META trades at a discount to MSFT and GOOGL on PEG despite faster revenue growth.
ideas.driver: Llama 4 enterprise API adoption; WhatsApp Business AI agent platform reaching commercial scale; Qualcomm Dragonfly AI inference reducing NVIDIA dependency; Quest/AR glasses reaching consumer mainstream 2027; advertising AI (AI Creative Studio, Advantage+) driving CPM growth above inflation; Samsung AI data center demand context validates AI compute investment thesis.
ideas.risk: EU Digital Markets Act (DMA) compliance creating structural European advertising disadvantage; FTC breakup action (spin off Instagram/WhatsApp); Reality Labs losses don't decelerate to breakeven by 2027; Llama 4 open-source enables competitors to commoditize META's AI advantage.

ideas.name: Procure Space ETF
ideas.idea: STEP ASIDE near-term (through July 10 bond distribution clearance + Nasdaq 100 inclusion). Long-term: SPCX is the most concentrated public access to the commercial space economy. Samsung Blue House ($226B AI data centers at national scale) creates the demand context for SpaceX Starlink (AI satellite connectivity for edge AI data centers globally) and Starshield (DoD AI infrastructure at sovereign scale). The $89B demand for $25B SpaceX bonds confirms the institutional valuation thesis at $500B+ implied enterprise value.
ideas.why: SpaceX is the defining infrastructure company of the 2020s–2030s: Starlink (5M+ paying subscribers, $20B+ estimated ARR), Starshield (DoD strategic priority, $70B+ contract ceiling), Falcon 9 (95%+ global commercial launch market share), Starship (10–50x cost reduction vs. current HLV). Samsung $226B AI data centers = demand for satellite connectivity, edge AI infrastructure, and sovereign AI compute that SpaceX Starlink and Starshield directly serve. Nasdaq 100 inclusion July 7 creates the second permanent passive demand channel in 12 days. September 2 first earnings provides the first-ever SpaceX revenue and subscriber data — if Starlink profitability is disclosed, it re-rates the entire ETF. Starpipe (Texas natural gas pipeline filing) confirms Starship launch cadence commitment.
ideas.driver: Samsung Blue House AI data center demand creates Starlink/Starshield AI connectivity thesis for September 2 earnings; SpaceX IPO speculation (2027–2028 base case, $500B+ implied); Starship reaching full commercial operations (first crewed Mars precursor by 2028); Starlink profitability confirmation; DoD Starshield contract awards; Cursor AI ($1M+ developers) September 2 disclosure; Nasdaq 100 + Russell 1000 additions (permanent passive demand); December 9 lock-up expiry (float expansion).
ideas.risk: Bond distribution mechanics persist beyond July 10; Starship development setback; SpaceX decides against IPO indefinitely; $150 IG floor closes below — forces lower re-entry; December 9 lock-up expiry creates 9–14% float expansion before September 2 earnings anchor; Samsung competition with Starlink in AI satellite connectivity (Samsung's own satellite program).

ideas.name: Bitcoin / US Dollar
ideas.idea: Structural digital gold thesis intact — re-entry framework governs the tactical timing. BTC is at $60,198 (Crypto.com MCP live, 11:02 UTC June 28) with Day 6 exit gate active and re-entry clock inactive. Fear & Greed at 13 (Extreme Fear) is the strongest contrarian accumulation signal of the 2026 cycle. Samsung Blue House ($646B AI/semiconductor commitment) is the cross-asset risk-on catalyst for potential June 29 UTC close above $62,000 (Day 1 re-entry clock). Long-term target: $120,000–$180,000 on the post-halving supply/demand cycle.
ideas.why: The April 2024 halving cut block reward from 6.25 to 3.125 BTC — approximately $5B/year of new supply removed at current prices. BlackRock IBIT, Fidelity FBTC, and ARK 21Shares collectively absorbed 3–5x daily new supply since January 2024. IBIT June 26 outflow ($445M) represents the second-largest single-day redemption — historical pattern: peak-outflow sessions in ETF cycles precede recovery windows within 5–15 sessions. Fear & Greed at 13 has historically preceded 15–30% recoveries within 10–20 sessions. US Strategic BTC Reserve legislation gaining Congressional support. Samsung $646B Blue House announcement is the most powerful cross-asset AI demand signal of the 2026 cycle — risk-on catalyst that could activate the June 29 $62,000 gate.
ideas.driver: Post-halving supply shock fully materializing (18–24 month cycle = late 2025 to mid-2026 peak); Samsung Blue House cross-asset risk-on June 29 → potential June 29 UTC $62,000 gate activation; spot BTC ETF net inflows resuming after risk-off period clears; institutional treasury adoption accelerating; US Strategic BTC Reserve legislation; Fear & Greed 13 contrarian accumulation signal at cycle level.
ideas.risk: BTC drops below $58,100 (June 25 session low) before re-entry clock activates — breach activates $57,500 structural target; regulatory action (SEC, CFTC, G7 coordinated); Mt. Gox final distribution creating sustained selling; macro risk-off (global recession) correlating BTC with equities; Samsung Blue House risk-on absorbed without BTC reaching $62,000 gate.
